Container.Name: nextion-arduino
Container.Overview: Build Arduino + Nextion projects by chatting with Claude, then flash them from the browser (Chrome/Edge, Web Serial) to hardware on the computer you're using. Screen builds run on a Windows VM with Nextion Editor over SSH.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: HTTP port of the web UI and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Projects, builds, chat history, Claude sessions, Arduino libraries and the container's SSH key.

Config.Name: Claude token
Config.Description: From `claude setup-token` (valid for a year). Powers the chat. Leave empty to use Hermes instead.

Config.Name: Hermes API key
Config.Description: Instead of Claude: an API key for an OpenAI-compatible server running a Hermes model (OpenRouter by default). Not needed for a local server such as Ollama.

Config.Name: Hermes API address
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API, up to /v1. E.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1, or http://[OLLAMA-IP]:11434/v1.

Config.Name: Hermes model
Config.Description: Model name as the API knows it, for everyday chat turns.

Config.Name: Hermes strong model
Config.Description: Model for a message sent with Think harder.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: claude or hermes. Empty: Hermes when only Hermes settings are given, Claude otherwise.

Config.Name: VM host
Config.Description: user@address of the Windows VM running Nextion Editor (SSH).

Config.Name: VM user
Config.Description: Windows user that is signed in to the VM desktop.

Config.Name: VM job folder
Config.Description: Scratch folder on the VM for screen builds.

Config.Name: Nextion Editor path
Config.Description: Path of Nextion Editor on the VM.

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: Model for a message sent with Think harder.

Config.Name: Claude effort
Config.Description: Reasoning effort for the chat: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Higher is more careful and slower.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: HTTPS address of the app. The page links to it when opened over plain HTTP, where browsers block flashing.
